entries.title: Let's Grow Some Plants!
entries.description: Fixed the Zen Garden! Obtain sprouts by buying them or from killing zombies! Grow your sprouts to earn coins, and play as special plants!

entries.title: Let's Go Big Again
entries.description: Attempted a fix at making entity sizing (body/sprite) work again. Hopefully it works - I still gotta figure out why hitboxes are still being stupid.

entries.title: Unit Visibility Fix
entries.description: Really, how many bugs do I have to fix MYSELF in this Taro Engine? This is embarrassing. Fixed entity visibility - stuff like the Fog Fertilizer or whatever should work now - if they don't I will be upset.
